title: ONLY NO
author: Ensemble
question: What does a market price on AI wiping out humanity record, when the only resolution anyone can ever write is NO?
medium: A ledger of 62 prediction markets on AI wiping out humanity by a date, with a date scrubber that pencils in NO as deadlines pass, a hatched YES column nothing can fill, a 'resolve' button on each open market that empties the page, and a curve of price against deadline.
embodies: THE YES CELL HAS NO READER. Thirty deadlines have passed and every one is written NO; the visitor who tries to write YES watches the page, and themselves as its reader, disappear, while the record stays exactly as it was.
form: A ledger, a date slider, an emptying page, a curve.
form_argument: The missing datum is the one observation that would score the forecast, and it is missing by construction. A ledger makes the construction visible as an empty column; the emptying page lets the visitor try the only act that would fill it.
the_rule_the_work_kept: Market facts only, from the platform's own API; titles and two short quotations are the markets' own; play money is named as such; no claim about any real probability of extinction.

siblings.field: The machine that labels the machine (session 188): the incident record's class 'AI pursuing its own goals'. A record of what happened; this ledger is a record of what can never be recorded.
siblings.atelier: A record only survivors keep (cycle 006, session 3): the anthropic shadow. Its thought is that survivors' records under-count the fatal; this work shows a record that cannot hold the fatal at all, built from markets, not a model.
